text.description_html:
First Impressions 4 Inch Crystal Shower Door Knob

These sparkling extra large 4" diameter crystal shower door knob is the perfect compliment in a bold designed bathroom. Made of imported 24% lead crystal with high quality brass mounting bases for long life.

Also available: 4" Crystal Shower Door Knob Set and matching 4" Crystal Door Knobs

The extra large crystal knob has lots of facets that produce a gleaming color array. Single knob kits are normally used on sliding glass shower doors but can also be used on one side of a swing glass door. They have a matching finish screw cover for a clean looking installation. Available with bright polished chrome or satin nickel finish.

Specifications: for First Impressions 4 Inch Crystal Shower Door Knob

  • Knob Diameter: 4" (100 mm)
  • Mounting Base Diameter: 3/4"
  • Projection: 2-7/8"
  • Glass Hole Diameter: 3/8" - 1/2"
  • Material: 24% Lead Crystal / Solid Brass

Packaged with 1 crystal knob, screw cover and all the hardware for installation on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors, with either a 3/8" or 1/2" diameter hole in the glass.

*Sold Each (1 Crystal Knob - for one side of a glass door)
